sql: SELECT t1.family, t2.company_name, t1.comp_mid_usd FROM fct_posting AS t1 INNER JOIN dim_company AS t2 ON t1.company_key = t2.company_key WHERE t1.is_open AND t1.remote_us AND t1.is_canonical_listing AND t1.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.family ORDER BY t1.comp_mid_usd DESC) = 1
